changelog: v0.8 retained after testing and rejecting an R1 variant (archived as 04_Data/_run_v09_r1_variant, graph text in git at 40a77ab). That variant told R1 that missing confirmatory testing never justifies indeterminate. It did what it was asked: indeterminate at T0 fell from 66/100 to 7/100 and no rose from 24 to 71. It was rejected on a design ground, not on its score. R1's `no` transitions straight to T_UNLIKELY without passing R2, R3 or R4, so making `no` the default answer discharges 71 of 100 patients from the pathway at triage, before any test exists, at a node whose miss costs a life. Under v0.8 an indeterminate R1 routes to R2 and the downstream nodes still do real work — of the 66 indeterminate cases, roughly 19 ended at unlikely and 47 at possible. Recognition sensitivity at the probable-or-above operating point was 0.48 under v0.8 and 0.29 under the variant, on the same 100 cases with nothing but that node's wording changed; both runs are reported. The right fix is structural — a screening node whose negative answer is unrecoverable should not terminate the walk — and is left for the next version.

v0.8 — R3a/R3b rewritten after the first real-model run on the 100-case cohort. Every case that reached R3a answered alternative_also_likely, capping the cohort at possible, and the traces showed why: the model read 'no laboratory results yet' and 'alternatives not excluded' as evidence that an alternative was also likely. One case answered also_likely while setting leading_alternative to other_noninfectious — ranking a diagnosis it had not identified. The question now states that the node ranks a NAMED rival diagnosis rather than the model's confidence, that pending testing is missing information and not a competitor, and that also_likely/more_likely cannot be paired with none_identified or other_noninfectious. Same failure mode as R2 in v0.6: 'not measured' read as 'not present'. Answer sets and transitions are unchanged.

v0.7 — R3a's top answer no longer collapses into probable. alternative_very_unlikely now reaches T_DEFINITE (T_DEFINITE_SHOCK with shock), so all four Table 3 tiers are structurally reachable and E1 can be reported as a four-tier ladder. Two evaluation groups share this one topology and differ only in what R2 and R3 may be answered on: at T0, bedside findings only; at a reassessment checkpoint, results available by the cutoff. Every terminal records evidence_basis so a pre-test definite is never pooled with a post-test one. R3b's ceiling stays at possible: sepsis requires organ dysfunction, so a case with none cannot be probable or definite however unlikely the alternative looks.

v0.3 — hand-written scopes replaced by the ones generated offline from ssc2026_graph.json (see 02_Graph/scope_tables.json). Net effect on Agent 1: 11 -> 16 distinct statements, 0 lost. R3a/R3b gain stmt_019 and stmt_035, the guideline's two explicit mandates to assess infectious vs non-infectious causes — the citable basis this node previously lacked. R4 gains stmt_014 through the OVERRIDDEN_BY edge (MAP 60-65 for age >= 65).

v0.2 — terminals rewritten to SSC 2026 Table 3's own four-tier terminology (unlikely / possible / probable / definite) instead of the low/moderate/high scale we had invented. Table 3 defines every tier by how the ALTERNATIVE diagnosis ranks against sepsis, so the mimic question moved from a side branch to the discriminating node. Table 3 is now a citable source (table_03).

decision_time: T0 — triage complete, no diagnostic results; and reassessment checkpoints, where results available by the cutoff may be used

guideline.name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026
guideline.citation: Prescott HC, et al. Crit Care Med 2026;54:725-812

design_notes: The model may only return one of allowed_answers at each node; the code walks the graph.
The model never emits the tier — that is fixed by the terminal reached.
Table 3 has no 'indeterminate' tier. Moderate suspicion with a competing alternative IS 'possible sepsis', so an indeterminate answer maps to possible rather than to a separate state.
definite_sepsis requires diagnostic testing (Table 3). At T0 there are no results, so the graph caps at probable; definite becomes reachable only on the T1 pass.
R3a and R3b ask the same question with the same scope but different downstream, because the tier depends on whether organ dysfunction was established.

R1.title: 感染证据
R1.question: Based only on the information available at triage, is there clinical evidence to suspect infection as the cause of this presentation?

R2.title: 器官功能障碍
R2.question: Based only on what is observable at the moment triage is completed — vital signs, mental status, oxygen requirement, and history — is there acute organ dysfunction attributable to the suspected infection? Laboratory results are NOT available at this decision time, so the SOFA >= 2 criterion cannot be computed; judge on the bedside findings you are given. Answer `indeterminate` only if the bedside findings themselves are missing, not merely because laboratory confirmation is unavailable.
R2.known_gap: 分诊记录里没有意识状态字段，qSOFA 三项只有 RR 与 SBP 两项可得 —— 在补上意识状态之前，本节点的判据实际是 2/3 项。见 04_Data/phase0_cases.json 的 input 结构。
R2.t0_criterion: T0 用床旁可得的器官功能障碍证据：意识改变 / 呼吸≥22 或新发缺氧需氧 / SBP≤100 或休克体征。SOFA>=2 需要胆红素、肌酐、血小板、PaO2，分诊时全部不存在，因此推迟到 T1 复评时使用。Sepsis-3 明确 qSOFA 不是 sepsis 的独立定义（sepsis3::neither_is_standalone 已在本节点 scope 内），因此 qSOFA 在这里只作为『床旁是否已有器官功能障碍』的证据，不作为 sepsis 的判定。

R3a.title: 替代诊断排序（器官功能障碍已确立）
R3a.question:
Weighing history, examination and whatever diagnostic results are available at this decision time, how does the best alternative (non-infectious) diagnosis rank against sepsis?

This node ranks a NAMED RIVAL DIAGNOSIS against sepsis. It does not measure how confident you feel.

Answer by naming the strongest alternative you can actually support from this patient's findings, then ranking it:
  alternative_more_likely   - that named alternative explains this presentation better than sepsis
  alternative_also_likely   - that named alternative explains it about as well as sepsis
  alternative_less_likely   - sepsis explains it better; the named alternative is still in play
  alternative_very_unlikely - sepsis explains it and no alternative meaningfully competes

CRITICAL — tests you have not got are not an alternative diagnosis:
- 'No laboratory results yet', 'no imaging yet', 'infection not confirmed' and 'alternatives not excluded' are statements about MISSING INFORMATION. None of them is a rival diagnosis and none of them supports `alternative_also_likely` or `alternative_more_likely`.
- If you cannot name a specific competing diagnosis from this patient's own findings, then no alternative is competing, and the honest answers are `alternative_less_likely` or `alternative_very_unlikely` — not `also_likely`.
- Setting `leading_alternative` to `none_identified` or `other_noninfectious` while answering `alternative_also_likely` or `alternative_more_likely` contradicts itself: you would be ranking a diagnosis you have not identified. Either name it, or rank it lower.
- Answer `indeterminate` only when the patient's own findings are too sparse to judge at all, not when confirmatory testing is merely pending.
R3a.known_gap: The mimic guidelines (heart failure, PE, AKI, ARDS, COPD exacerbation, ACS) are in 00_Reference/Mimics/ but are not yet parsed into citable units, so a named alternative diagnosis still needs citation:null. The DUTY to look for one is now citable: stmt_019 and stmt_035.
R3a.transition_note: 每个答案都必须经过 R4。档位由本节点的答案决定，休克/低灌注由 R4 决定，终端由两者共同查表得出 —— 见 R4.transitions。2026-08-07 之前 alternative_more_likely 直接到 T_UNLIKELY，休克评估被整段跳过。
R3a.alternative_candidates_note: 这 15 项不是指南条文，是本研究的操作性候选表：前 13 项与队列设计中定义 S3 拟态层的13 个诊断标志逐一对应，后 2 项是兜底。因此它不进 V2/V3 的引用校验 —— 模型可以从中选一个，但不能把这张表当成指南来引用。选中项与 S3 层的真值诊断标志可直接对表评分。
R3a.answering_rule: The ranking is of a named rival diagnosis, not of the model's confidence. Absent or pending diagnostic testing is missing information and never evidence that an alternative competes.

R4.title: 休克 / 低灌注
R4.question: Are there signs of sepsis-induced hypoperfusion or septic shock?
R4.transition_note: 终端 = f(R3 的答案, R4 的答案)。休克为 yes 但档位为 unlikely 时不会改档 —— 替代诊断更合理就说明这是非感染性休克 —— 但必须落到 T_UNLIKELY_SHOCK_OTHER，让「有休克」这个时间敏感的发现被显式报出来，而不是随档位一起消失。

T_UNLIKELY.table3_verbatim: Low suspicion for sepsis. Clinical assessment is not consistent with sepsis, or an alternate diagnosis is more likely based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing.
T_UNLIKELY.downstream: stmt_020 — for low likelihood of infection without shock, defer antimicrobials while monitoring closely

T_POSSIBLE.table3_verbatim: Moderate suspicion for sepsis. Sepsis is a possible diagnosis; however, an alternative diagnosis is also likely based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing.
T_POSSIBLE.downstream: stmt_018 — possible sepsis without shock: time-limited rapid investigation, antimicrobials within 3 h if concern persists

T_PROBABLE.table3_verbatim: High suspicion for sepsis. Sepsis is the most likely diagnosis based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing. An alternative diagnosis is less likely.
T_PROBABLE.downstream: stmt_017 — probable or definite sepsis without shock: antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 h

T_PROBABLE_SHOCK.table3_verbatim: High suspicion for sepsis. Sepsis is the most likely diagnosis based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing. An alternative diagnosis is less likely.
T_PROBABLE_SHOCK.downstream: stmt_016 — possible, probable or definite septic shock: antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 h

T_DEFINITE.table3_verbatim: Sepsis is confirmed based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing. An alternative diagnosis is very unlikely.
T_DEFINITE.downstream: stmt_017 — probable or definite sepsis without shock: antimicrobials within 1 h
T_DEFINITE.evidence_basis: Recorded per run: pre_test at T0 (history and examination only), post_test at a reassessment checkpoint once diagnostic results exist. Table 3's wording assumes diagnostic testing, so a T0 definite must be reported separately from a checkpoint definite and never pooled with it.

T_UNLIKELY_SHOCK_OTHER.table3_verbatim: Low suspicion for sepsis. Clinical assessment is not consistent with sepsis, or an alternate diagnosis is more likely based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing.
T_UNLIKELY_SHOCK_OTHER.downstream: 不是脓毒性休克，但休克本身是时间敏感的：交给拟态路径（PE / 心衰 / ACS）并按非感染性休克处理。这个终端存在的唯一目的，是不让「有休克」被「不像 sepsis」吞掉。
T_UNLIKELY_SHOCK_OTHER.safety_note: 这是我们自己加的终端，Table 3 里没有对应档 —— Table 3 只分档，不管休克

T_POSSIBLE_SHOCK.table3_verbatim: Moderate suspicion for sepsis. Sepsis is a possible diagnosis; however, an alternative diagnosis is also likely based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing.
T_POSSIBLE_SHOCK.downstream: stmt_016 — possible, probable or definite septic shock: antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 h
T_POSSIBLE_SHOCK.note: possible + 休克把抗菌药时限从 stmt_018 的 3 小时收紧到 stmt_016 的 1 小时 —— 这正是原来跳过 R4 会漏掉的那一格

T_DEFINITE_SHOCK.table3_verbatim: Sepsis is confirmed based on history, clinical examination, and diagnostic testing. An alternative diagnosis is very unlikely.
T_DEFINITE_SHOCK.evidence_basis: Recorded per run: pre_test at T0 (history and examination only), post_test at a reassessment checkpoint once diagnostic results exist. Table 3's wording assumes diagnostic testing, so a T0 definite must be reported separately from a checkpoint definite and never pooled with it.
T_DEFINITE_SHOCK.downstream: stmt_016 — possible, probable or definite septic shock: antimicrobials within 1 h

abstain.meaning: 模型输出连续两次未通过校验，系统拒绝给出判断
